paragraph.input: We propose <style id='1'>Adam</style>, a method for efficient stochastic optimization that only requires first-order gra- dients with little memory requirement. The method computes individual adaptive learning rates for different parameters from estimates of first and second moments of the gradients; the name <style id='3'>Adam</style>is derived from adaptive moment estimation. Our method is designed to combine the advantages of two recently popular methods: AdaGrad (Duchi et al., 2011), which works well with sparse gra- dients, and RMSProp (Tieleman & Hinton, 2012), which works well in on-line and non-stationary settings; important connections to these and other stochastic optimization methods are clarified in section 5. Some of Adam’s advantages are that the magnitudes of parameter updates are invariant to rescaling of the gradient, its stepsizes are approximately bounded by the stepsize hyperparameter, it does not require a stationary objective, it works with sparse gradients, and it naturally performs a form of step size annealing.

paragraph.input: Interestingly, although both Adam and Adagrad make rapid progress lowering the cost in the initial stage of the training, shown in Figure 3 (left), Adam and SGD eventually converge considerably faster than Adagrad for CNNs shown in Figure 3 (right). We notice the second moment estimate {v1}vanishes to zeros after a few epochs and is dominated by the {v2}in algorithm 1. The second moment estimate is therefore a poor approximation to the geometry of the cost function in CNNs comparing to fully connected network from Section 6.2. Whereas, reducing the minibatch variance through the first moment is more important in CNNs and contributes to the speed-up. As a result, Adagrad converges much slower than others in this particular experiment. Though Adam shows marginal improvement over SGD with momentum, it adapts learning rate scale for different layers instead of hand picking manually as in SGD.

paragraph.output: 我们还通过实验评估了第 2 节和第 3 节中解释的偏置校正项的影响。如第 5 节所述，移除偏置校正项会得到一个带动量的 RMSProp（Tieleman & Hinton, 2012）版本。我们在训练变分自编码器（VAE）时改变 {v1} 和 {v2}，该 VAE 采用与（Kingma & Welling, 2013）相同的架构：单个隐藏层包含 500 个带有 softplus非线性 的隐藏单元，以及一个 50 维球面高斯隐变量。我们遍历了范围很广的超参数选择，即 {v3} 和 {v4}，以及 log{v5}（{v6}）{v7}。接近 1 的 {v8} 值是实现对稀疏梯度鲁棒性所必需的，但会带来更大的初始化偏置；因此我们预计，在这种衰减缓慢的情况下，偏置校正项非常重要，可以防止其对优化产生不利影响。
paragraph.pdf_unicode: We also empirically evaluate the effect of the bias correction terms explained in sections 2 and 3. Discussed in section 5, removal of the bias correction terms results in a version of RMSProp (Tiele- man & Hinton, 2012) with momentum. We vary the β1 and β2 when training a variational auto- encoder (VAE) with the same architecture as in (Kingma & Welling, 2013) with a single hidden layer with 500 hidden units with softplus nonlinearities and a 50-dimensional spherical Gaussian latent variable. We iterated over a broad range of hyper-parameter choices, i.e. β1 ∈ [0, 0.9] and β2 ∈ [0.99, 0.999, 0.9999], and log10(α) ∈ [−5, ..., −1]. Values of β2 close to 1, required for robust- ness to sparse gradients, results in larger initialization bias; therefore we expect the bias correction term is important in such cases of slow decay, preventing an adverse effect on optimization.

The method is straightforward to implement, is computationally efficient, has little memory requirements, is invariant to diagonal rescaling of the gradients, and is well suited for problems that are large in terms of data and/or parameters. The hyper-parameters have intuitive interpre- tations and typically require little tuning. Some connections to related algorithms, on which <style id='3'>Adam </style>was inspired, are discussed. We also analyze the theoretical con- vergence properties of the algorithm and provide a regret bound on the conver- gence rate that is comparable to the best known results under the online convex optimization framework. Empirical results demonstrate that Adam works well in practice and compares favorably to other stochastic optimization methods. Finally, we discuss<style id='5'>AdaMax</style>, a variant of <style id='7'>Adam </style>based on the infinity norm.

paragraph.input: Stochastic gradient-based optimization is of core practical importance in many fields of science and engineering. Many problems in these fields can be cast as the optimization of some scalar parameter- ized objective function requiring maximization or minimization with respect to its parameters. If the function is differentiable w.r.t. its parameters, gradient descent is a relatively efficient optimization method, since the computation of first-order partial derivatives w.r.t. all the parameters is of the same computational complexity as just evaluating the function. Often, objective functions are stochastic. For example, many objective functions are composed of a sum of subfunctions evaluated at different subsamples of data; in this case optimization can be made more efficient by taking gradient steps w.r.t. individual subfunctions, i.e. stochastic gradient descent (SGD) or ascent. SGD proved itself as an efficient and effective optimization method that was central in many machine learning success stories, such as recent advances in deep learning (Deng et al., 2013; Krizhevsky et al., 2012; Hinton & Salakhutdinov, 2006; Hinton et al., 2012a; Graves et al., 2013). Objectives may also have other sources of noise than data subsampling, such as dropout (Hinton et al., 2012b) regularization. For all such noisy objectives, efficient stochastic optimization techniques are required. The focus of this paper is on the optimization of stochastic objectives with high-dimensional parameters spaces. In these cases, higher-order optimization methods are ill-suited, and discussion in this paper will be restricted to first-order methods.
paragraph.output: 基于随机梯度的优化在科学与工程等诸多领域中具有核心的实践意义。这些领域中的许多问题都可以转化为对某个标量参数化目标函数的优化，即针对其参数进行最大化或最小化。如果该函数对其参数可微，那么梯度下降就是一种相对高效的优化方法，因为计算所有参数的一阶偏导数与仅仅计算函数值具有相同的计算复杂度。目标函数往往是随机的。例如，许多目标函数由在不同数据子样本上求值的子函数之和构成；在这种情况下，通过对单个子函数执行梯度步骤可以使优化更加高效，即随机梯度下降（SGD）或随机梯度上升。SGD 已被证明是一种高效且有效的优化方法，在许多机器学习的成功案例中处于核心地位，例如近年来深度学习的进展（Deng et al., 2013; Krizhevsky et al., 2012; Hinton & Salakhutdinov, 2006; Hinton et al., 2012a; Graves et al., 2013）。除数据子采样外，目标函数还可能存在其他噪声来源，例如随机失活（Hinton et al., 2012b）正则化。对于所有这些带噪声的目标函数，都需要高效的随机优化技术。本文的重点是对具有高维参数空间的随机目标函数进行优化。在这些情况下，高阶优化方法并不适用，因此本文的讨论将仅限于一阶方法。

If the function is differentiable w.r.t. its parameters, gradient descent is a relatively efficient optimization method, since the computation of first-order partial derivatives w.r.t. all the parameters is of the same computational complexity as just evaluating the function. Often, objective functions are stochastic. For example, many objective functions are composed of a sum of subfunctions evaluated at different subsamples of data; in this case optimization can be made more efficient by taking gradient steps w.r.t. individual subfunctions, i.e. stochastic gradient descent (SGD) or ascent. SGD proved itself as an efficient and effective optimization method that was central in many machine learning success stories, such as recent advances in deep learning (Deng et al., 2013; Krizhevsky et al., 2012; Hinton & Salakhutdinov, 2006; Hinton et al., 2012a; Graves et al., 2013). Objectives may also have other sources of noise than data subsampling, such as dropout (Hinton et al., 2012b) regularization. For all such noisy objectives, efficient stochastic optimization techniques are required. The focus of this paper is on the optimization of stochastic objectives with high-dimensional parameters spaces. paragraph.input: We evaluate our proposed method on L2-regularized multi-class logistic regression using the MNIST dataset. Logistic regression has a well-studied convex objective, making it suitable for comparison of different optimizers without worrying about local minimum issues. The stepsize {v1}in our logistic regression experiments is adjusted by {v2}decay, namely {v3}that matches with our theorat- ical prediction from section 4. The logistic regression classifies the class label directly on the 784 dimension image vectors. We compare Adam to accelerated SGD with Nesterov momentum and Adagrad using minibatch size of 128. According to Figure 1, we found that the Adam yields similar convergence as SGD with momentum and both converge faster than Adagrad.
paragraph.output: 我们在 MNIST 数据集上评估了所提出方法用于 L2 正则化多分类 Logistic 回归的表现。Logistic 回归具有已被充分研究的凸目标，因此适合用于比较不同优化器，而无需担心局部最小问题。在我们的 Logistic 回归实验中，步长 {v1} 通过 {v2} 衰减进行调整，即 {v3}，这与第 4 节中的理论预测相符。该 Logistic 回归直接基于 784 维图像向量对类别标签进行分类。我们将 Adam 与带 Nesterov 动量的加速 SGD 以及 AdaGrad 进行比较，小批量大小为 128。根据图 1，我们发现 Adam 的收敛与带动量的 SGD 相似，且二者都比 AdaGrad 收敛更快。
paragraph.pdf_unicode: We evaluate our proposed method on L2-regularized multi-class logistic regression using the MNIST dataset. Logistic regression has a well-studied convex objective, making it suitable for comparison of different optimizers without worrying about local minimum issues. The stepsize α in our logistic regression experiments is adjusted by 1/√t decay, namely αt = α√t that matches with our theorat- ical prediction from section 4. The logistic regression classifies the class label directly on the 784 dimension image vectors. We compare Adam to accelerated SGD with Nesterov momentum and Adagrad using minibatch size of 128. According to Figure 1, we found that the Adam yields similar convergence as SGD with momentum and both converge faster than Adagrad.

paragraph.input: First, we study different optimizers using the standard deterministic cross-entropy objective func- tion with {v1}weight decay on the parameters to prevent over-fitting. The sum-of-functions (SFO) method (Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2014) is a recently proposed quasi-Newton method that works with minibatches of data and has shown good performance on optimization of multi-layer neural net- works. We used their implementation and compared with Adam to train such models. Figure 2 shows that Adam makes faster progress in terms of both the number of iterations and wall-clock time. Due to the cost of updating curvature information, SFO is 5-10x slower per iteration com- pared to Adam, and has a memory requirement that is linear in the number minibatches.
paragraph.output: 首先，我们使用标准的确定性交叉熵目标函数研究不同的优化器，并对参数施加 {v1} 权重衰减以防止过拟合。函数和（SFO）方法（Sohl-Dickstein 等人，2014）是最近提出的一种拟牛顿法，可处理小批量数据，并已在多层神经网络的优化中表现出良好性能。我们使用了他们的实现，并将其与 Adam 进行比较来训练此类模型。图 2 显示，无论从迭代次数还是实际耗时来看，Adam 的收敛速度都更快。由于更新曲率信息的代价，SFO 每次迭代的耗时比 Adam 慢 5-10 倍，且其内存需求随小批量数量线性增长。
paragraph.pdf_unicode: First, we study different optimizers using the standard deterministic cross-entropy objective func- tion with L2 weight decay on the parameters to prevent over-fitting. The sum-of-functions (SFO) method (Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2014) is a recently proposed quasi-Newton method that works with minibatches of data and has shown good performance on optimization of multi-layer neural net- works. We used their implementation and compared with Adam to train such models. Figure 2 shows that Adam makes faster progress in terms of both the number of iterations and wall-clock time. Due to the cost of updating curvature information, SFO is 5-10x slower per iteration com- pared to Adam, and has a memory requirement that is linear in the number minibatches.

paragraph.input: Stochastic regularization methods, such as dropout, are an effective way to prevent over-fitting and often used in practice due to their simplicity. SFO assumes deterministic subfunctions, and indeed failed to converge on cost functions with stochastic regularization. We compare the effectiveness of Adam to other stochastic first order methods on multi-layer neural networks trained with dropout noise. Figure 2 shows our results; Adam shows better convergence than other methods.
paragraph.output: 随机正则化方法（如随机失活）是防止过拟合的有效手段，因其简单性而在实践中被广泛使用。SFO 假定子函数是确定性的，因此在带有随机正则化的成本函数上确实无法收敛。我们在使用 dropout 噪声训练的多层神经网络上，比较了 Adam 与其他随机一阶方法的效果。图 2 展示了我们的结果；Adam 表现出比其他方法更好的收敛性。
